_README: 图解英文翻译。键是 assets/figures 下的文件名，text 里是「原文 → 英文」逐条替换；aria 是整张图的无障碍描述。跑 node tools/build-figures-en.mjs 生成 assets/figures/en/*.svg。

calculator.svg.aria: How a calculator works: a key connects a wire, the chip runs a program, the screen shows digits with seven little bars

text.按下 3 + 5 = 以后，机器里发生了什么: What happens inside after you press 3 + 5 =
text.它不会思考，只是把「怎么算」提前写死在芯片里: It does not think — someone wrote how to calculate into the chip long ago

candy-tooth.svg.aria: Bacteria eat sugar and spit acid; the acid soaks holes in the tooth's armour; deep enough, it reaches the nerve

text.烂牙的不是糖，是糖喂出来的「酸」: What rots teeth is not sugar — it is the acid that sugar feeds
text.糖越黏、吃的时间越长，细菌越开心: The stickier and longer, the happier they are
text.② 细菌吐酸，把盔甲泡软: ② They spit acid, softening the armour
text.一次一点点，泡久了就脱了一层: A little each time — wear it down
text.③ 洞越来越深，碰到神经就疼: ③ Deeper, until it hits the nerve
text.一次吃完一块糖，比一整天慢慢吃要好——关键不是「吃了多少」，是「酸泡了多久」。: One sweet at once beats one all day: what counts is how long the acid soaks.

canteen.svg.aria: Wrapping dumplings one by one is too slow; one big pot is quick

text.食堂要一次喂饱几百人，比的是「快」和「稳」: A canteen feeds hundreds: it needs speed and safety
text.水饺 / 圆子：一个一个包: Dumplings / rice balls: one by one
text.熟得透、够热、同样的钱更划算: Cooked through, still hot, more for the same money

cloud-float.svg.aria: Three panels: a cloud is countless tiny droplets a gentle updraught can hold; a person is one big lump the wind cannot lift; to fly you need wings that push air, or a balloon lighter than air

text.小水珠会飘，人只会往下掉: Tiny droplets float; people just fall
text.每颗只有头发丝的几分之一: Each a fraction of a hair
text.② 人是一整块: ② A person is one lump
text.或者像热气球，比空气轻: Or a balloon, lighter than air
text.关键不是「轻」，是「摊得开」：同样重量，越小、迎风面越大，风越托得住: Not lightness but spreading out: small pieces catch the wind

copy-paste.svg.aria: Three steps to put a picture into WPS: find it, Ctrl+C to copy, Ctrl+V to paste

text.把图片放进 WPS：三步就好: Put a picture into WPS in three steps
text.① 找到图片，点一下选中: ① Find it, click to select
text.网页上的图片：在图上点右键 →「复制图片」: On a web page: right-click the picture → Copy Image
text.手机上：长按 →「复制」，到 WPS 里长按 →「粘贴」: On a phone: long-press → Copy; long-press in WPS → Paste
text.Ctrl+X 是「剪切」：把它搬走，原来的位置就空了: Ctrl+X is cut: it moves the thing, leaving an empty spot

crab.svg.aria: Female crabs have a round apron, males a pointed one

text.把螃蟹翻过来，看肚子上那块「脐」: Flip the crab over and look at the flap on its belly
text.要抱一肚子卵宝宝，所以又圆又宽: Full of eggs, so it is wide and round

fishoil.svg.aria: A little orange-red capsule of DHA, the building block for brain and eyes

text.橘红色的小胶囊里，装的是大脑和眼睛的材料: Orange-red capsule: material for brain and eyes
text.DHA 就像盖房子用的砖：大脑和眼睛长好要用一点点，但好好吃饭比吃胶囊更重要。: DHA is a building brick: brain and eyes need a little, but eating well matters more.

insurance.svg.aria: Many people pay into one pool; the few who need help draw from it

text.很多人各交一点点 → 攒成一个大池子: Many people each pay a little → one big pool
text.出事的人来领钱: The few who claim draw from it
text.一年真出事的只有几十人，剩下的是成本、准备着明年赔的钱，再剩下才是赚的。: A few dozen claim a year; after costs, the rest is profit.

laputa-robot.svg.aria: The garden robot runs on Laputa's glowing stone; when the city fell it stopped

text.它不是流血死的，是「没劲了」: It did not bleed to death — it ran out of power
text.② 劲儿来自城里的石头: ② Power from the city's stone

mirror-flip.svg.aria: Three panels: light bounces off a mirror like a ball off a wall; light from both hands goes straight there and back, so the left hand stays left; laid flat, the mirror keeps left and right but flips up and down

text.镜子翻的是「前后」，不是左右: A mirror flips front-and-back, not left-and-right
text.光直着去、直着回，没有交叉: Light goes straight there and back — no crossing
text.② 左还是左，右还是右: ② Left is left, right is right
text.③ 平放镜子：上下反了: ③ Flat: up and down flip
text.镜子把正对你的那一面原样送回来；觉得「反了」，是大脑替你脑补了一次转身: Mirror returns the facing side; reversed is your brain adding a turn.

money-why.svg.aria: Three panels: barter was awkward; then everyone agreed on a ticket anyone accepts; you take the goods, leave a ticket, and the shopkeeper trades it for what he needs

text.钱，是大家都认的一张「票」: Money is a ticket everyone accepts
text.一只鸡换一袋米: One chicken for a bag of rice
text.要换的人不一定在: The right person may be away
text.② 于是大家约定一张票: ② So they agreed a ticket
text.钱不是给老板的「礼」: It is not a gift to the shop
text.是换走东西的凭证: A receipt for what you took
text.钱本身不能吃也不能玩，它只是一张大家都肯认的「换东西的票」: Money is not food or a toy: it is the ticket everyone trusts.

moon-follow.svg.aria: Three panels: walk a few steps and nearby trees slide behind you; the moon is so far that its direction hardly changes, so it seems to follow

text.为什么你走，月亮也跟着走？: Why does the moon follow you?
text.几步就到身后: Behind you in a few steps
text.② 树退到身后了: ② The tree is behind you
text.不是月亮在跟着你，是一路上的东西退得太快: The moon is not following; everything else is sliding back too fast

mosquito.svg.aria: A mosquito spits saliva; your body's guards release histamine; the skin swells and itches

text.不是蚊子咬得痒，是你的小卫士在打架: The bite does not itch — your little guards are fighting
text.防止血凝固、堵住吸管: So blood will not clot its straw

pangu-axe.svg.aria: A timeline in three layers: Pangu in the third-century story has no axe; the Ming book gives him an axe and a chisel; today's cartoons copy that

text.那把斧子，是明朝人给他配上的: The axe was given to him by a Ming storyteller
text.只写「天地混沌如鸡子，盘古生其中」: Only: heaven and earth like an egg, Pangu inside
text.天地是他一天长一丈撑开的——靠身体，不靠工具: He held them apart, ten feet a day — his body, not tools
text.明代《开辟衍绎》：左手执凿，右手持斧: Ming retelling: chisel left, axe right
text.这部书第一次给他配上两件工具，「或斧劈，或以凿开」: First to give him tools — cutting with axe or chisel
text.因为说书人要一个看得见的动作：劈开: A storyteller needs a visible motion: splitting
text.斧子成了盘古的「标配」，凿子反而常被忘掉: The axe became his standard prop; the chisel was forgotten
text.所以「斧子哪来的」——答案在明代说书人手里: So where did the axe come from? From a Ming storyteller's hands
text.神话会解释世界怎么来的，却很少解释自己的道具哪来的。: Myths explain where the world came from, rarely where their props did.

plugin.svg.aria: A USB stick carries stuff; a plugin is a socket that adds a skill

text.U 盘装的是「东西」，插件装的是「本领」: A USB stick carries things; a plugin carries skills
text.拔掉以后，东西还在盘里: Unplug it and the things stay
text.插件：给软件加一样本领: Plugin: gives a program a skill
text.比如浏览器装了挡广告插件，就多会挡广告: Add an ad blocker and the browser blocks ads

sleep.svg.aria: Three panels: adenosine builds up while you are awake; while asleep, fluid washes it away; the day's memories are copied into the long-term book

text.困，是大脑攒了一天的「垃圾」: Sleepiness is a day's rubbish piled up
text.所以睡觉不是浪费时间，是大脑在打扫 + 存档: Sleep is not wasted time: it is cleaning plus saving

toys.svg.aria: Old toys were a hoop, a shuttlecock and a beanbag; now it is a tablet

text.爸爸妈妈小时候的玩具：动手做 + 出门跑: Toys when Mum and Dad were little: make it, run outside
text.厂院子里、院子里: In the yard, in the lane
text.一个人、一块屏幕、随时能玩: One kid, one screen, any time

why-scold.svg.aria: Three panels: spilling the water is the mistake; grown-ups worry you will get hurt; the telling-off is about the thing, and liking you has not changed

text.大人批评的，是那件事，不是你: Grown-ups scold the thing, not you
text.批评的是一件小事: It is about a small thing
text.下次可以问一句：为什么不可以？: Next time ask: why can't I?

photo-pink.svg.aria: Three panels: old photos are built from cyan, magenta and yellow dyes; cyan fears sunlight and heat most and is slowly broken apart; once cyan is gone there is too little blue, red looks strong, and the photo turns pink

text.不是「变旧」，是青色先退场 —— 老照片要避光、干燥、别贴窗玻璃: Not aging: the cyan leaves first — keep old photos dark and dry

lightning.svg.aria: Three panels: tiny ice crystals and droplets bumping in a cloud prise charge apart, positive rising to the cloud top and negative staying at the bottom; when the charge piles up, the air between acts like a wall and gets punched through; the current races to the ground and the burned channel is the flash, while the suddenly heated air exploding outward is the thunder

text.水不是变成电，是碰撞把电分开 —— 云里的水是电池的原料: Collisions split the charge — water is the battery, not the current

traffic-lines.svg.aria: A top-down view of a two-way road: a dashed white line separates lanes going the same way and may be crossed, a solid white line may not; a double solid yellow line down the middle separates opposite directions and neither side may cross it; only a dashed yellow line allows overtaking, and a solid yellow line by the kerb means no parking

text.双黄实线：对向车道，两边都不许跨: Double solid yellow: opposite traffic, nobody may cross
text.黄虚线才准借道超车 ｜ 路边黄实线＝不能停车: only dashed yellow may be crossed to overtake ｜ solid yellow at the kerb = no parking

securities-firm.svg.aria: A flow diagram: an investor opens an account and places orders with a securities firm, which sends the order to the exchange to be matched and reports the fill back; a listed company issues shares for cash through the exchange; the firm earns commissions and service fees, not a share of the investor gains or losses

text.证券公司是中间那道柜台: A broker is the counter in between
text.它赚的是服务费，不是你的运气: It earns fees, not your luck
text.佣金 ｜ 代销基金 ｜ 融资融券利息 ｜ 上市发债服务费: commission | fund sales | margin interest | listing & bond fees

human-origin.svg.aria: People did not appear all at once: long ago the Earth had only fish and dinosaurs; then came ancestors that looked like apes; one generation at a time, they slowly became the people of today

text.人是慢慢变来的，不是一下子冒出来的: People came about slowly, not all at once
text.中间隔了几百万年：一代一代，只变那么一点点: Millions of years in between — one tiny change per generation

recycler.svg.aria: A flow diagram: cardboard boxes, empty bottles and old appliances that a household or neighbourhood wants to throw away are bought by weight at a very low price by the scrap collector, who then sorts them into paper, plastic and metal, bales them into one big pack and sells them by the tonne to paper mills, plastics plants, aluminium smelters and steel works; he earns the gap between the buying price and the selling price by collecting many households' small piles into one big truckload

text.他赚的是「把散的攒成一堆」的钱: He earns the gap of gathering the scattered into one pile
text.不是秤上占便宜，是把几十家的「一点点」攒成了一大车: Not a trick on the scale: many households' small piles into one big load

skewer-sticks.svg.aria: Three panels comparing skewers: firm cubed lamb needs just one stick; soft thin chives and enoki mushrooms need two sticks to clamp them so they do not curl and spin; a whole corn cob or whole chicken wing is big and heavy and needs two or three sticks to share the weight so it can be turned

text.签子几根，看它会不会打转: How many sticks? Depends on whether it spins
text.一根它会绕着转、往下滑: on one it spins and slides
text.一根签只是一根轴，东西能绕着它转；两根签就是两个支点: One stick is one axis: the food can spin around it. Two sticks are two pivots.
text.越软、越薄、越重，就越需要多一根——不是为了多，是为了不转、不散: Softer, thinner, heavier needs one more — not for show, but so it will not spin or fall apart

why-east.svg.aria: Two panels: from Europe, China lies east where the sun rises, so it is called the East; from the US, across the Pacific, the same China is west — the place did not move, the direction flipped

text.东方不是标签，是「站在哪里看」: East is not a label: it depends where you stand
text.太阳升起的那边，就叫「东」: the side where the sun rises is 'East'
text.Orient 原意：太阳升起的地方: Orient means: where the sun rises
text.② 换成美国人站中间: ② Now an American in the middle
text.隔着太平洋，中国在美国西边: across the Pacific, China is west of the US
text.方位没变，看的人换了: the place did not move; the viewer did
text.同一个中国，一步没动——变的是「谁在哪儿看」: Same China, not a step moved — only the viewer changed
text.所以东方、西方是相对的方位；后来才又叠上「筷子、汉字、茶」这层文化意思: East and West are relative directions; the cultural layer came later

what-is-revolution.svg.aria: Three rows: a political revolution changes who decides — from a king deciding alone to everyone voting; an industrial revolution changes how things are made — from one pair of shoes a day by hand to hundreds a day by machine; a scientific revolution changes how we decide what is true — from what the book says to what your own experiment shows. Bottom line: reform edits clauses in the same book; revolution replaces the whole book

text.革命换的不是一个人，是一整套做法: A revolution swaps a whole way of doing things, not one person
text.同一块地方，规矩整本换了: same place, the whole rulebook replaced
text.手工一天一双鞋: one pair of shoes a day by hand
text.没人喊口号，是一台台机器改的: no slogans — machines did the changing
text.判断对错的方法变了: the way we judge what is true changed
text.改革＝在同一本书里改条款 ｜ 革命＝把整本书换掉: Reform = amend clauses in the same book  |  Revolution = replace the whole book

why-trees.svg.aria: Three panels: the sun overhead, with grass, a shrub and a tree at different heights — whoever grows taller gets more light; leaves cook their own food from sunlight, water and air, making sugar and releasing oxygen; roots hold the soil so rain cannot wash it away, and a hole in the trunk becomes a bird's home. Bottom line: nobody arranged for trees — plants just raced for the sun and grew upward

text.树，是长得特别高的植物: A tree is just a very tall plant
text.树不是谁安排出来的：它们只是抢着晒太阳，一路往上长: No one arranged for trees: they raced for the sun and grew up
text.长得高一点就多一口饭；晒不到的那些，慢慢被林子筛掉: A little taller means a little more food; shaded ones drop out

what-is-cafa.svg.aria: Three panels: the name breaks into Central + Fine Arts + Academy, meaning an art university in Beijing, founded in 1918; inside you study fine art, design, architecture and art history; to get in you draw for years, then pass the art exam, CAFA's own exam, and the gaokao. Bottom line: CAFA is a school — not a painting, not a museum, though it has its own art museum.

text.央美，是一所教人画画的美术大学: CAFA is an art university that teaches people to draw
text.缺一环都进不去: Miss one and you are out
text.央美是学校，不是一幅画，也不是博物馆: CAFA is a school — not a painting, not a museum
text.不过它自己有一座美术馆，里面常办展览: Though it does have its own art museum

what-is-jazz-dance.svg.aria: Three panels: jazz dance grew out of jazz music — in 1920s America jazz was improvised and syncopated, and people danced to it; it is not a fixed set of steps but slamming on the heavy beats, moving the body in parts, adding your own flourishes; later it split into social swing, Broadway stage jazz and street jazz funk, which is what most classes teach today. Bottom line: jazz dance is not a tune, it is how you move to the tune.

text.爵士舞：跟着爵士乐跳出来的舞: Jazz dance: born from jazz music
text.爵士舞不是一首曲子，是「跟着曲子怎么动」: Jazz dance is not a tune — it is how you move to it
text.没有固定组合——同一首歌，两个人能跳出两个样子: No fixed routine: same song, two dancers, two different dances

corn-hang-dry.svg.aria: In northeast China winter, corn cobs hang on a raised wooden rack so the dry cold wind passes between them and carries the moisture away

text.挂在外面，是让玉米「晾干」: Hang it up, and the corn dries

why-parking-fee.svg.aria: One parking space across a day: when free, a single car stays all day and others circle looking for a space; when paid, three cars take turns and the space turns over. The money pays for the barrier, cameras, lighting, cleaning, repairs, insurance, land and taxes — free parking somewhere means someone else paid.

text.收费，收的是「占住一块稀缺的地」: The fee is not for parking — it is for holding a scarce piece of land
text.后来的车只能绕圈找位: Later cars just circle for a space
text.一辆接一辆，车位转起来: One after another — the space turns over
text.谁用它，谁付它的成本；钱也用来修新的车位: Whoever uses it pays its cost — and the money builds more spaces
text.免费的地方不是零成本：商场免 3 小时，是想让你进去买东西: Free parking is never zero-cost: a mall gives 3 free hours to get you inside to shop

bird-flock-shapes.svg.aria: A bird flock has no leader: each bird watches only its neighbours, moving away when too close and closer when too far, so the whole flock can turn into a cloud, a ribbon, or other shapes. Bottom line: no orders — each bird follows a few neighbours, and the flock moves like a piece of cloth

text.没有谁喊口令：每只鸟只看身边的几只: No orders, no leader — each bird watches its neighbours
text.一会儿圆，一会儿长: Round now, a long ribbon next
text.没有谁喊口令：每只鸟跟着旁边几只，整群就像一块会动的布: No orders at all — each bird follows a few neighbours, and the flock moves like a piece of cloth

hanging-gardens-babylon.svg.aria: Three panels: a king builds a garden for a queen who misses the mountains of home; the garden is a stack of terraces held up by arches, with river water lifted to the top and poured down; plants hang over the edges so it looks suspended in the air, but its ruins have never been found. Bottom note: the standard list is the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World — the Hanging Gardens is one of them; 'eighth wonder' is only a later phrase

text.空中花园：一座给王后解乡愁的梯田楼: A terraced garden built to cure a queen's homesickness
text.提水到顶层，再往下浇: Water lifted up, then poured down
text.标准说法是「古代世界七大奇迹」，空中花园是其中之一: The standard list is seven wonders, not eight
text.「第八大奇迹」只是后来形容了不起工程的说法，不是正式名单: An 'eighth wonder' is just a saying, not an official list

diaper-absorb.svg.aria: Cross-section of a diaper: pee drips from above and passes through the top layer, absorbent beads in the middle drink it into a soft jelly, and a waterproof film at the bottom keeps it from leaking — so clothes, sheets and skin stay dry

text.尿不湿怎么把尿「喝」进去？: How does a diaper drink up pee?
text.把尿不湿剪开，里面是这样的: Cut a diaper open — here is what is inside
text.① 表面层：尿一下子就穿过去，贴着皮肤这边还是干的: ① Top layer: pee passes through; the skin side stays dry
text.② 吸水小颗粒：把尿喝进去，变成软软的果冻: ② Absorbent beads: they drink the pee into soft jelly
text.③ 防水膜：像雨衣一样，挡住尿不让漏出去: ③ Waterproof film: a raincoat that stops leaks
text.小婴儿想尿就尿、说不了——尿不湿就是一条「会喝水的裤子」: Babies pee when they want and cannot say — a diaper is 'pants that drink'
text.吸走水、锁成果冻，衣服床单干干的，小屁股也不红不疼: Water is soaked up and locked in jelly: clothes stay dry and skin stays calm

why-igloo-not-cold.svg.aria: Cross-section of an igloo: outside −40℃, inside about 0℃. Snow blocks are full of trapped air, which does not conduct heat, so the walls work like a thick quilt. A person and an oil lamp give off heat; warm air stays in the dome, while cold air pools in the low entrance tunnel.

text.冰屋不冷：不是加热，是把热带住: An igloo traps heat; it does not make it
text.雪砖里的空气不导热，像一件厚棉被: Air trapped in snow blocks does not conduct heat — like a thick quilt

seashell-ocean-sound.svg.aria: A seashell held to the ear: sound from wind, cars, voices and a fan enters the shell; inside the hollow cavity the air vibrates back and forth and low notes are amplified; the sound reaches the ear and is heard as 'shhh — wha', like surf. Bottom line: the quieter the place, the fainter the 'waves' — it is the sound around you.

text.海螺里的“海浪”，是从哪儿来的？: Where does a seashell's 'sea sound' come from?
text.先记住：海螺里没有存着海水的声音: First: a seashell does not store the sound of the sea
text.周围的声音：风、车、人声、风扇…: Sound around you: wind, cars, voices, fans…
text.听到：哗——像海浪: You hear: shhh — wha, like surf
text.越安静的地方，“海浪”越小——它本来就是你身边的声音: The quieter the place, the fainter the 'waves' — it is the sound around you
